reviews.text: We asked the groomer not to shave the area around our dog's rear end, but she did as she pleased. As a result, he is suffering from alopecia, which has triggered the procedure.
Perfect, I highly recommend them. The people in charge of grooming cats and dogs are very professional.
Thank you for your positive feedback.

Always attentive when grooming my dog ​​- very careful and gentle work - I highly recommend them
Thank you for your positive feedback.

I had a truly wonderful experience today at Two Tails! I had the pleasure of meeting Ophélie and Laura, who took such good care of my Teddy, ensuring his well-being and grooming. When I arrived at the salon, I couldn't help but cry tears of joy because he looked so beautiful! He's never looked so handsome. I hope to see them again very soon, whether to chat, buy some food, or book another grooming appointment. Thank you for your professionalism and kindness 🙏
A team of groomers who listen and are attentive to the well-being of animals. Always a warm welcome, perfect grooming, and a happy dog. Excellent value for money with helpful advice included.
Thank you for your positive feedback.
Really friendly and knowledgeable staff. Great selection of toys and treats for my dog.
This is where we buy cat food.

I’ve waited for two full weeks for a grooming appointment for my dog and they just canceled on the same day because of some situation with their staff member. And said they would call to offer a new time slot, they never did until I called them.
And instead of trying to fix it and change the appointment to a sooner one, they gave me an appointment after 16 days. With no explanations!!!!
Really rude customer service!
Fantastic experience with a lovely, cheerful, and smiling salesperson! The shop is small, but you'll definitely want to come back 😊 …
Friendly. Selling cat food. And leashes, a very practical Curly harness. Shampoo, brushes, etc.
Thank you for the positive feedback!

I was looking for a muzzle for my dog, and as soon as I walked in, I received a very warm welcome and helpful service. They had exactly what I was looking for, and I think you'll find what you need there too. I highly recommend them to all dog lovers.
Excellent grooming salon for our pets; the shop is overflowing with treats that our furry friends love. I highly recommend it.
Thank you for your positive feedback!

A member of staff asked me if I wanted to enter despite the presence of a dog. I replied that I preferred to avoid it and wait until she finished shopping. Following this, another customer cut in front of me and entered with a dog, and I ended up waiting 25 minutes while the dog played with the other customer right in front of us. So we ended up waiting 45 minutes in front of a window, and in the end, we received no help other than hypocrisy because they didn't like the truth.
Second grooming session for Maya, my Cairn Terrier. Very meticulous work. A really good place that I recommend for grooming in the 15th arrondissement.
Excellent experience at Two Tails for grooming my miniature American Shepherd. I highly recommend them!

Great experience at Twotails for grooming! I appreciated being able to be present during my cat's grooming session. The staff are gentle, professional, and attentive to the animals' well-being. I recommend them 🐾 …

Two Tails Paris 15 is a perfect grooming salon. I brought my dog ​​Fendi (poodle) in. She returned him to me with baby-soft fur, spotlessly clean.
Don't hesitate. I'll be back.
A big thank you to Alizée for these tips, to help me choose items for my dog.
Thank you for the positive feedback.

20 euros for a nail trim and a quick comb is expensive!
10 euros for a nail trim is still acceptable, but when you offer an additional "combing," it's good to state the price beforehand, not at the register, especially when you comment, "Wow, there weren't many knots/hairs!" Obviously, our cat had been brushed that very morning... She even dared to call the cat aggressive when she was clearly defensive about getting her nails trimmed... We'll come back for the nail trim out of necessity, but the friendliness wasn't great!
The service in the shop, however, was pleasant :)

I arrived a little before opening time, but the person very kindly let me in anyway. They gave me lots of advice when I bought a dog bed. They offered to help me create a customer account. I'll be back for my dog's grooming 😄 …
Very nice shop
Excellent welcome and care for my little dachshund during his grooming. Thank you 🙏🏻 …

My little Maltese gets a superb grooming at this salon! We've known Ophélie for over 7 years, and her skills, patience, kindness, and attentiveness are what truly define her! If you haven't been to this salon, go check it out—your pet will be warmly welcomed and well cared for! Thank you, Ophélie!
Overpriced store, saleswoman who gives advice without knowing if the products are for young animals or adults, no questions or curiosity to advise me better, huge disappointment.
Thank you for your positive feedback.

Fantastic! The groomer was very kind and attentive to my cats.
They came back all 🤩 …
Friendly welcome, the shop isn't huge but offers a very good selection of products that you can't find elsewhere
Pleasant welcome and kind responses to my requests
Warm welcome
I've lived in Paris for a year and I really appreciate the service at Two Tails Paris15. The staff are friendly. It's the best place to buy things for my dog.
Thank you for your positive feedback. See you soon :)
Thank you for your positive feedback. See you soon :)
Very friendly staff, quality products.

My dog's second home! Daisy has always been welcomed like family by Alizée and Ophélie, who are fantastic: very professional, always smiling, and always welcoming.

However, a slight disappointment with the new employee (Anthony?), who was frankly unpleasant: he didn't say a word or even look at me during my entire visit to the shop. I even ended up leaving and will come back to shop on a day when he wasn't there. I imagine he's still finding his feet, but it's a shame because the rest of the team is really great! This won't stop me from coming back with my dog ​​for her toys, treats, grooming, or just some cuddles from the team!

(I'd also like to take this opportunity to say a quick hello to Karel, who is sorely missed by the customers, and to William, who we don't see often but is always in a good mood!)

A very nice shop and the people who work there are very kind and welcoming.
Have a good day everyone.
Mr. Ouari, dog trainer Paquito
A very warm welcome, I am very satisfied with my dog's grooming.
Always bring our dog here. Very nice people and our dog is all clean after. Excellent job!

A very bad experience. Beyond the unpleasant attitude, the complete lack of professionalism is blatant. Our cat wasn't even taken into consideration, which is unacceptable for a professional who is supposed to be attentive to animals. We absolutely do not recommend this salon.
Thank you for this positive review.
Thank you for this positive review.
Excellent saleswoman

The store is clean and well-maintained. There's a wide selection. You can buy individual items, which is great for introducing different flavors to our picky babies! The staff are always welcoming and friendly, and they're attentive to our little ones' needs. Thank you so much. I highly recommend this store.
Thank you for your positive feedback :)
Always warmly welcomed and advised, I always enjoy coming to shop and chat!
Nice experience.
I found what I needed; it has excellent items!

A huge thank you to Ilona at Two Tails! She takes care of my Cavalier King Charles with exceptional gentleness and care. Always a warm welcome, perfect grooming, and a happy dog. I highly recommend her!

I'm very happy with Ophélie's services for grooming and caring for my little poodle. Ophélie is very attentive, kind, and highly competent!

Plus, she removed two ticks from my little Loulou the other day, and he's always so happy to see her!
They should add more fans because with this heatwave... it must be very difficult to work in these conditions!
Excellent store. Friendly staff and a great grooming salon.
Lovely shop, warm welcome, very professional staff. I take my dachshund there for a good grooming... excellent results! My dog ​​always goes there willingly!

First time for my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel at this grooming salon, a successful experience, very welcoming, the staff are very kind and respectful. The cut perfectly matched my request.
I would definitely go back.
